subjective.text: Mary Smith is twenty eight years old and lives at apartment four oh five, nine C Clerkenwell Road.
The headache started yesterday around mid-morning on the left side of her head.
Her mother has a history of hypertension and migraines.
She works as a designer and doesn't smoke or drink alcohol regularly.
Mary Smith hasn't had her blood pressure checked recently.
Her partner lives with her at home.

assessment.text: The pain is localized to the left side of her head and started around mid-morning yesterday.
There are no other symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, tingling, numbness, weakness, blurred vision, or problems with light sensitivity associated with the headache.
She has not taken any other medications regularly and only took Nurofen yesterday for her headache.
Her blood pressure was not checked recently due to no family history of hypertension or similar issues.

plan.text: The doctor prescribed Paracetamol for Mary Smith and advised her to take rest, have good hydration, and return if the pain worsens or new symptoms appear.
